title: 第3128章 影无痕的不断偷袭第3127章 神魔悟太极凤凰八涅盘
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
“影族的杂碎！
你找死！！”
骸诡怒吼，来不及完全转身，背后骨甲疯狂增生，同时操控数具最强的金甲尸傀不顾一切地扑向身后，试图阻挡。
但影无痕的这一击太快太毒！
噗嗤——！
阴影之刺虽然被增生的骨甲和金甲尸傀阻挡了大部分威力，未能刺入后脑要害。
却依然刺穿了骸诡的肩胛骨，一股阴毒至极、专门侵蚀生机的影毒瞬间注入！
“啊——！”骸诡发出一声痛苦的嘶吼，肩胛骨处瞬间变得漆黑，并且那黑色还在向周围血肉蔓延！
他体内的尸气疯狂涌动，试图逼出影毒，但影毒如附骨之蛆，极难驱除。
更让他惊怒的是，一击得手后，影无痕的身影再次消散，毫无踪迹。
“混账！我要将你炼成尸傀，永世折磨！”骸诡咆哮，气息因为影毒和伤势而变得紊乱，操控的尸傀阵列也出现了破绽。
而就在骸诡受伤、尸傀阵列出现混乱的同一时刻。
距离他不远，刚刚因叶凰突破而收回目光的叶羽，眼中寒光一闪！
“好机会！”
他早就看这个不断用岩刺骚扰自己、又擅长防御的大地始源族源始不顺眼，更对那个浑身死气的尸族骸诡没有好感。
此刻骸诡受伤，正是重创甚至除掉一个潜在敌人的好时机！
至于影无痕？
藏头露尾的虫子，稍后再找！
“九阳焚天，霸拳镇世！”
叶羽长啸一声，不再理会那些中等族群天骄的骚扰，九轮大日骤然合一，化作一轮炽烈到极致的“霸阳”！

他整个人与霸阳合一，化作一道金色的火焰流星，带着焚尽八荒，霸烈无双的恐怖气势，不是冲向最近的源始，而是直取受伤的骸诡！
这一拳，不仅蕴含了九阳圣龙霸天体的全部力量，更带着叶羽那不容侵犯、镇压一切的霸道意志！
拳锋所过之处，大道本源退避，空间扭曲，那些挡在路上的尸傀如同纸糊般被气浪掀飞、点燃！
骸诡刚被影无痕偷袭重伤，正全力压制影毒，哪料到叶羽会在这个时机，以如此霸道的方式突袭而来？
他惊恐地抬头，只看到一轮焚烧天地的金色太阳在眼前急速放大！
“不——！！
大地始源族的！
助我！！”骸诡绝望嘶吼，疯狂催动所有尸傀挡在身前，同时向不远处的源始求救。
他们之前虽无交情，但此刻面对叶家雷霆一击，或许能暂时联手？
源始面色变幻。
他确实不想看到叶家再轻易除掉一个强敌，但叶羽这一拳的威势太恐怖了。
他若硬接，即便能挡住，自身也必受重创，在这危机四伏的战场，重伤几乎等于死亡……
电光石火间，源始咬牙，做出了决定。
他没有直接上前硬撼叶羽，而是双手再次按向虚空，地脉祖皇道场光芒大放，却不是攻击叶羽。
而是在骸诡身前瞬间升起一道厚重无比、闪烁着玄黄光泽的“大地之墙”！
同时，无数粗大的岩刺从地面爆射而出，刺向叶羽的侧面，试图干扰，减缓他的攻势。
他选择了最稳妥的方式——尽力阻挡，干扰，让骸诡自己承受主要攻击。
content_en:
“ShadowClan bastard!
You are looking for death! ! "
The corpse ghost roared, and before he could turn around completely, the bone armor on his back grew wildly. At the same time, he controlled several of the strongest golden-armored corpse puppets to rush behind him desperately, trying to stop him.
But Ying Wuhen's blow was too fast and too poisonous!
Pfft——!
Although most of the power of the shadow thorn was blocked by the proliferating bone armor and golden armor corpse puppet, it failed to penetrate the vital part of the back of the head.
But it still pierced through the shoulder blade of Guigui, and an extremely sinister shadow poison that specially eroded vitality was instantly injected!
"Ah——!" Zugui let out a painful roar, and his shoulder blades instantly turned pitch black, and the blackness was still spreading to the surrounding flesh and blood!
The corpse energy in his body surged crazily, trying to force out the shadow poison, but the shadow poison was like maggots attached to the bones and extremely difficult to get rid of.
What made him even more shocked and angry was that after the successful attack, Ying Wuhen's figure disappeared again without a trace.
"Bastard! I will turn you into a corpse puppet and torture you forever!" the skeleton roared, his aura becoming disordered due to shadow poison and injuries, and the corpse puppet array he controlled also had flaws.
At the same moment when the corpse was injured and the corpse puppet array was in chaos.
Not far from him, Ye Yu, who had just looked away due to Ye Huang's breakthrough, had a cold light in his eyes!
"Good opportunity!"
He had long disliked the Earth Origin Clan who constantly harassed him with rock thorns and was good at defense, and he even disliked the Corpse Clan Zhigui who was full of lifeless energy.
At this moment, the skeleton is injured, which is a good time to seriously injure or even eliminate a potential enemy!
As for Ying Wuhen?
Hidden bug, find it later!
"Nine suns burn the sky, and the domineering fist rules the world!"
Ye Yu let out a long roar and ignored the harassment from the geniuses of the middle-class ethnic groups. The nine-round sun suddenly merged into one, turning into an extremely blazing "Bayang"!
His whole body merged with Ba Yang and turned into a golden flaming meteor. With the terrifying aura of burning all the wastes and unparalleled Ba Lie, he did not rush towards the nearest source, but went straight to the injured corpse!
This punch not only contains the full power of the Nine Yang Holy Dragon Tyrant Celestial Body, but also carries Ye Yu's inviolable and domineering will to suppress everything!
Wherever the fist passed, the source of the avenue retreated, the space was distorted, and the corpses blocking the road were blown away and ignited by the air waves like paper!
Gui Gui had just been seriously injured by Ying Wuhen's sneak attack and was trying his best to suppress Shadow Poison. How could he have expected that Ye Yu would attack in such a domineering way at this time?
He looked up in horror, only to see a golden sun burning the heaven and earth rapidly magnifying in front of his eyes!
“No—!!
From the Origin Clan of the Earth!
Help me! ! "Zuigui screamed in despair, frantically urging all the corpse puppets to block in front of him, and at the same time asked for help from Yuanshi not far away.
Although they had no friendship before, but now facing the Ye family's thunderous attack, maybe they can temporarily join forces?
Yuanshi's complexion changed.
He really didn't want to see the Ye family easily get rid of another powerful enemy, but the power of Ye Yu's punch was too terrifying.
If he takes a hard hit, even if he can block it, he will be severely injured. In this dangerous battlefield, serious injury is almost equivalent to death...
In the blink of an eye, Yuanshi gritted his teeth and made a decision.
He did not directly step forward to shake Ye Yu, but pressed his hands into the void again. The Earth Vein Ancestral Emperor's Dojo shone brightly, but it did not attack Ye Yu.
Instead, an extremely thick "Wall of the Earth" with a dark-yellow luster instantly rose up in front of Zugui!
At the same time, countless thick rock thorns shot out from the ground and stabbed at Ye Yu's side, trying to interfere and slow down his offensive.
He chose the safest way - trying his best to block, interfere, and let the skeleton bear the main attack.
